findings.disposition_rationale: cmdAdmit mint-guard comment reworded to name ensureOwnerOnlyDir/writeOwnerOnlyJson as the earliest side effect; emit rebuilt (50669b91).

A process killed between open and rename can leave a 0600 temp file inside a 0700 key directory; only the same OS user can read it. Sweeping strays would delete files in key directories; spec review already recorded this as a non-gating observation.

A non-directory at a key-directory path fails at the temp-file open with ENOTDIR naming the path, the same error class the previous writeJson mkdir raised; ensureOwnerOnlyDir follows the spec pseudocode.
--force test now also rotates a 0644 producers/P1.json and asserts 0600 with no temp file (dcaf326f).
